comments.body:
Since I assume `get_num_hops` is not called every batch iteration in most cases, we could possibly do something fancy without any performance concerns, but I'm not sure if there's a robust way to count the number of hops.

As a quick fix, we can update the docs as you suggest :)

comments.body: Thanks for the issue. Added a note in the doc for now: https://github.com/pyg-team/pytorch_geometric/pull/8723. Leaving this issue open in case we want to come up with a more principled solution.
